text_block_list.text:
A strategy meeting was held with Zenno Rob 
Roy and Sweep Tosho regarding the "Reading 
Promotion Week" event, but――

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's with that massive stack of 
paper?! A spellbook?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No...? These are materials summarizing the 
recommended highlights of the books I 
picked out.
choice_data_list:
This amount... might be a bit 
overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's gonna want to read all that! You 
have to make it easier to understand, like 
Grandma does!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was magic to change flower 
colors or pull birds from boxes, Grandma 
always demonstrated it right before my 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it was way easier to understand 
than reading some thick spellbook♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I see...
choice_data_list:
Letting them experience it might be a 
great idea.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If we're doing it... maybe an exhibit 
booth that recreates the best scenes from 
the books... perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! It'll be so much fun, like 
stepping right into the book♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then the main concept for the event is 
set! Now, what else do we need――
choice_data_list:
We should probably put effort into 
costumes too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's true... no matter how hard we work on 
the exhibits, it won't mean anything if 
nobody comes to see them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If we go to a busy street where lots of 
people pass by... we might find some good 
examples.

—And so, after paying the bill, we decided 
to explore the streets outside the cafe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Handing out flyers and calling out to 
people are classics... but it'd be great 
if we had something extra to grab their 
interest.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's Magical☆Dabi-ko! Dabi-ko is 
really here~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did you say Dabi-ko!? Where, where is 
she!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-Sweep-san!? Please wait up... !

text_block_list.name: Magical Girl Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Magi-magi☆Magical♪ In the 
『Magical☆Dabi-ko Returns!』 show, watch 
Dabi-ko make a dazzling heroic display☆

text_block_list.name: Magical Girl Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
All you good boys and girls! Let's meet at 
the event stage in just a bit♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going! I'm going! I'm absolutely 
going~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, both of you! We're going to watch 
the Dabi-ko show!
choice_data_list: What about looking for promo ideas!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It should be fine, I think... ! Because 
we just witnessed the perfect reference...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was thinking maybe we could 
promote it just like Dabi-ko-san did.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Instead of just calling out to people, if 
we act in-character like they just did, we 
can capture so much more interest...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It might be a little embarrassing... but 
if we promote it in the bustling central 
plaza, surely...!
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea, let's do it

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! If it's as a magical girl, 
I wouldn't mind doing it♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, then this time we can truly go to 
the Dabi-ko show with peace of mind♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(With the two of them beside me, I know 
it'll be okay... ...I will definitely 
convey the charm of our event...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, if we can bring out the story's 
atmosphere more, the immersion will be so 
much deeper...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Atmosphere, huh... how are we supposed to 
bring out something so fluffy and vague?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that Cafe over there! It's rare 
to see her drinking black tea.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That is true... I thought Cafe-san was a 
die-hard coffee enthusiast—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wh-What was that!? A blackout!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Thank goodness, the lights are—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!? Again!?
(RATTLE RATTLE RATTLE...!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hiiieee...!? Now there's a weird sound... 
!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I-Is it safe this time, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... You all... were here too, I 
see...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Cafe-san, didn't you just walk in 
from the entrance...?
choice_data_list: Then who was that person we just saw...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I don't think I can go back to 
that shop for a while...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What was that even about, geez! It's not 
even a haunted house, so why did that...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... it felt just like something out 
of a horror novel—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... just like back there, with lighting 
and sound— if we pay close attention to 
the staging, don't you think we can build 
a great atmosphere...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It was terrifying... but maybe we 
managed to find a wonderful reference... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's true, I've had more than 
enough of that kind of scare~~!!

And so, alongside the two teary-eyed 
girls, we headed home for the day.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, not only the exhibits, but the 
staff's costumes are also important.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! For the magical story corner, 
there's gotta be someone who looks the 
part!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I recall... there were live outfits 
that matched a fantasy worldview.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then let's use that! What about the rest? 
Should we borrow them from somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Wouldn't Fuji-senpai know a lot 
about costumes...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She used to be a child actor, so she must 
know places with an abundant selection of 
stage costumes...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thanks to you girls, this year's 
『Reading Promotion Week』 is shaping up 
to be quite exciting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave the costumes to me; I'll check with 
some acquaintances. We should be able to 
get our hands on almost anything.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yay! You're actually pretty useful♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I could never let cloud settle in the eyes 
of a pony-chan working so earnestly, after 
all... To protect that smile, no trouble 
is ever too great.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... w-wahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
F-Fuji-senpai's words... why do they 
always make my heart beat so fast, I 
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Perhaps it's because I want to make 
your heart flutter, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A single line of dialogue can drastically 
sway the listener's emotions. ...The same 
holds true for stage acting.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What kind of person are they? What do they 
think, what do they wish to convey— You 
envision it clearly in your mind as you 
perform.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do that, and the audience will naturally 
be drawn right into the world of the 
story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Into the world... of the story...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you please teach us more? The 
core principles of acting... !

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If those guiding the event fully embody 
the characters, I'm certain it will make 
the event even more wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A piece of cake! For a pony-chan who loves 
stories so deeply, I'd gladly roll up my 
sleeves to help.

Afterwards, receiving advice from Fuji 
Kiseki regarding the essence of 
performance, I felt as though we had grown 
a bit wiser.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...And so, that is the concept for the 
exhibition corner we would like to hold to 
convey the wonders of literature.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to share the charm of books with 
everyone... I don't want these magnificent 
stories to remain buried!

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...True, if we do it that way, everyone 
might really take an interest.

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It sounds like hard work, but I'd 
love to try. I want people to know about 
the books I love too!

Zenno Rob Roy's passion reached the 
library committee members, and the plan 
for the event was successfully approved. 
All that was left now was to prepare for 
the big day—
